name: PostHog
summary: Read the product analytics signals you choose for a recipe.

setup.credential_label: PostHog connection approved in your own Hermes setup
setup.recommended_scope: Read-only access to the product analytics you choose to summarize.
setup.customer_action: In your own setup, connect PostHog with read-only access and choose the project signals this recipe may read.

customer_setup.summary: Choose the product signals you want explained in plain language.
steps: Pick the PostHog project and analytics signals that matter.
Approve read-only access inside your own Hermes setup.
Review one test summary before enabling a schedule.
customer_setup.secret_handling: Agent Recipes never asks for, displays, stores, or logs connection secrets. Complete authorization only in your customer-owned runtime.

verification.success_looks_like: A test brief reports only the selected PostHog signals and cannot alter analytics settings or data.
steps: Confirm the selected product signals appear in the plan.
Confirm no PostHog settings or data were changed.

rollback.scope: Only the PostHog connection for this selected recipe.
steps: Pause this recipe before changing its connection.
Remove only this recipe's PostHog connection in your own runtime.
Leave unrelated recipes and PostHog connections unchanged.
